title: One persist function for chat turns
evidence: Survey 2026-11-25: the three write sites differ in client (web: user-scoped createUserClient; bots: supabaseAdmin), timing (web writes conversation and question before the model call and fails the turn on either; bots write after the reply), conversation lookup (web: create; Discord: create if none; YouTube: find-or-create by comment id), answer-row failure (web and Discord: no event; YouTube: event with null message_id), timestamp touch (web and Discord yes; YouTube no) and error reporting. Done: the chat_match_events row is built by one function on every surface, matchEventRow in app/lib/chat-persist.server.ts (US-15 AC73, S-1 step 1); the column mappings (routerColumns, matchEventText, answerColumns) were already shared. Left: the answer row (S-1 step 4), then the question row and conversation create, which first need the owner's ruling on the answer-row failure path and the write timing; the pins (US-15 AC70) guard each move.
